The game is really fun but I have a game breaking bug that won't let me play the MyRise mode because as soon as I start a match I have no control over my character. The MyRise is the main mode I was looking forward to as well.

Edit: I figured out the issue. It was on my end. I had a wireless Guitar Hero controller plugged in and the game was reading it as Player 1 and for some reason in MyRise it was defaulting the Player 1 controller as the only controller. It didn't do this for the first 2 chapters but then it did everytime after. I unplugged it and now it works.

I was really excited to play this game. Unfortunately, every time I've tried to play, I run into the same glitches.
1) eventually, if not right away, I am unable to do anything but walk and light strike. Can't grapple, get in and out of ring, or climb turnbuckle. There's probably more.
2) sometimes when knocked to the ground, my character will just lay there not moving, and the opposing wrestler doesn't do anything while standing over me. The match doesn't continue. I have to quit out.
3) getting stuck in animations. I'm Irish whipped into the ropes and my character just keeps running in place. I climb the top turnbuckle and my character glitches into a jcvd split

I'll give the game another chance if they release something to fix this, but until then, be careful buying this.

Such a fun game! I've been a huge fan of WWE games since SVR 2006. This game graphically looks magnificent, plays super smooth. I've played 100% of the time on my steam deck (with Windows 11 install) and it plays like a dream!

I'm currently riding the Levesque Era hype train and that heavily influences how I feel about the game at the moment. That being said I haven't put any amount of time into a wrestling game since probably 2010 and this is a nice change from the games back then. The MyGM and Universe have all the things I expected them too so far, even if I wish more from Universe was in MyGM I understand why it isn't. 

The gameplay itself is a nice change of pace from the formula I was used to, each direction when you grapple does a different move. Going with a 'neutral' 'towards' 'away' approach feels easier on the player, you just have to be sure that the wrestler you're using has a move for that option in their move set.

If you haven't played a wrestling game in a few years, it feels like a purchase that is totally worth it. If you're someone who only purchases wrestling games when they've made enough changes from the couple of previous years, besides adding and removing roster characters/legends, I can't weigh in on whether it's worth it.

The reversal system in these games is such garbage. Rather than being triggered at an intuitive moment during move animations where you can learn it and get a feel for it, every reversal window feels different and you have a split second to respond to the reversal prompt popping up. There is zero fun to be had when you are missing reversal after reversal, sometimes you even land one successfully and then the animation of you stumbling to your feet is STILL slower than your opponent can attack again, how is that right that you score a reversal and still you are not able to capitalize before your opponent can attack you again. I've been playing wrestling games since WWF Raw and Royal Rumble on Genesis. I know what decent gameplay feels like.

Also all the 2K microtransaction BS stuffed into the game.

Can't skip cutscenes, can't adjust copy past move sets from created character to myrise (story if you can call it that). It took me literally 8 hours just to flesh out a move set and now I can't copy past it? Also from what I've seen of reviews online, the Custom character mode is super short. I wish I'd known all of this before I bought it. I miss the older days where the Custom characters were the focus as was the story.

Best thus far of the WWE 2K series of games in my humble opinion!

Fantastic All-new match types to choose from, huge roster of stars plus additional DLC superstars, and extra content! Love the story mode in 2K24 MyRise, & the amount of control you have over Universe mode is far greater than previous versions of the series too! 2K Showcase of the Immortals is very fun, & MyFaction is entertaining as always. MyFaction updates often, & is always adding new weekly challenges with great un-lockable content. By far one of my favorite modes in this game as always is playing MyGM, which this year has expanded options, and has longer season GM match ups for an overall better GM experience!

I highly recommend WWE 2K24, so be sure to grab it while it's still in full swing. Every years brings a new 2K WWE game out, so don't miss out on this one. Grab it on sale if you must, just be sure to get it before years end! ^_^ In the immortal words of Randy himself "OooooOOOooohhhHHH YEEEAAAHHH"!!! -Macho Man

Playing WWE 2K24 with R-Truth is like going on a rollercoaster ride with a comedian who also happens to be a wrestling superstar. From his entrances where he forgets where the ring is to his in-match antics that leave you in stitches, Just when you think you've seen it all, he pulls out his invisible friends for a tag team match, and you find yourself wondering if you're playing a wrestling game or starring in a sitcom. Trust me, WWE 2K24 with R-Truth isn't just a game, it's a laugh-out-loud experience that'll have you shouting 'What's Up?!' at your screen every time you pick up the controller
